Comment.value: Dwarven Defender initiation reagent (roadmap: dwarven-defender-quest). Given by the headstone of Balin in Balin's Tomb (q_dwd_stone OnUsed, instance tag DwdBalinStone) only when the standing PC wears heavy armor (QDWD_IsStoneClad in q_dwd_inc -- chest armor's BASE AC from parts_chest.2da is 6+, i.e. splint/banded/half-plate/full plate; the module's zep_cr_canca.nss base-AC idiom, immune to enhancement-bonus fakery). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_dwd_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_dwd_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it. BaseItem 24 + ModelPart1 44 copied from the sibling reagents (q_dvc_light et al).

value.0: A single clean-edged shard of grey granite, heavier in the hand than stone has any right to be, given up by the headstone of Balin, son of Fundin, Lord of Moria. The tomb parts with it only for a dwarf who stands at the grave as Balin's guard stood -- in the war-weight of Khazad, splint and plate, iron enough to be a wall -- and it cannot be set down, sold, or handed off. The Defenders call it a shard of the unbroken stone: proof that the stand was kept in full iron, and it means nothing to anyone but Halmir the Grey, who keeps the Defenders' page on his roll of the old orders.
